title: Aaron Rodgers 2023 Panini Prizm Football - #227 - New York Jets QB
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2023 Panini Prizm Football trading card featuring Aaron Rodgers, quarterback for the New York Jets in the National Football League (NFL). The card is part of the base set and is made of card stock, with a standard size and Prizm parallel/variety. It is in English and unsigned by Rodgers. This collectible item is a must-have for fans of the Jets or Rodgers, showcasing the player in the upcoming 2023 season.
